label: VERIFIED
scope: Exact R28 fixing-source comparison against the delivered R27-derived working baseline; not Git history or exhaustive manual source review.

changes.before: French branding was labelled Dutch by a four-language ternary.
changes.after: Uses the existing complete UI_LOCALE_OPTIONS registry, retaining all five languages.
changes.reason_and_execution: The real Manager branding response now labels the French section French.

changes.before: Cart mutations blindly persisted the middleware session snapshot; concurrent adds lost another request's product.
changes.after: Applies each add/update/remove intent to the latest stored cart using cart revision and exact JSON compare-and-swap, retrying at most32 times. Saturation returns an explicit409 instead of false success.
changes.reason_and_execution: Forced same-snapshot real HTTP additions preserve both products; eight same-product adds accumulate; concurrent update/remove preserves unrelated latest changes.

changes.before: An unchanged GET/cart incremented revision, rotated checkout bearers and erased its saved quote. Stale normalization/coupon clearing could replace newer state.
changes.after: No-op writes do not change revision/quote/bearers. Normalization and conditional coupon clearing use the exact revision/state read by that request.
changes.reason_and_execution: Actual GET leaves revision/quote unchanged; missing product cleanup invalidates once; old readers cannot overwrite newer cart/coupon/quote.

changes.before: Parallel issuance could both pass cooldown and create two active tokens; an insert failure could delete the previous token.
changes.after: Cooldown read, previous-token deletion and insertion share one write transaction.
changes.reason_and_execution: Eight concurrent calls produce one issuance; injected insert failure preserves the prior usable token.

changes.before: Password changed before a separately executed session-revocation failure, leaving the new credential and old sessions active.
changes.after: Credential update, reset-token invalidation and authenticated/pending-MFA session revocation commit together; a stale expected password hash cannot authorize another change.
changes.reason_and_execution: Injected revocation failure preserves old password/all sessions; success preserves only the current session, or none for local/default recovery.

changes.before: Manager email could commit before revocation failed, while the route incorrectly reported a duplicate-email409.
changes.after: Manager-only email change and revocations are transactional; only the actual users.email uniqueness error is classified as duplicate. Other failures return500 without a committed change.
changes.reason_and_execution: Injected failure preserves the original email; true duplicate409 preserves state; successful replacement revokes authenticated and pending-MFA sessions except the current one.

changes.before: Anonymous repeat requests reset confirmed/in-flight stock-alert consent to pending and sent another confirmation.
changes.after: Conflict updates are limited to pending or previously sent alerts; confirmed and sending states retain their consent/delivery claim.
changes.reason_and_execution: Actual confirmed and sending rows survive repeats; a previously sent alert may request fresh confirmation again.
